name: Part-based Occupancy Network
definition: A part-based occupancy method that treats the human body as objects hinged by multiple bones, establishing an occupancy field for each bone. It learns rigid transformations and local non-rigid deformations separately.
summary: Part-based Occupancy Networks represent articulated shapes by decomposing them into bone-hinged parts with separate rigid and non-rigid deformation networks, distinguishing themselves from monolithic implicit fields.
